items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The diff is the same as the reference. Names reveal intent (compile_json_path_final_key, HasKeyOrArrayIndex), and a comment explains why the final key is compiled differently. Formatting matches the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Adds an overridable hook and a two-line subclass instead of copying SQL, reuses compile_json_path for the leading segments, and leaves no per-backend copies or dead code.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: json.dumps quotes the final key correctly. No new error paths and no magic constants. Hidden tests all pass (F2P 2/2, P2P 78/78).

items.name: Array-index semantics kept for isnull / exact=None paths
items.name_zh: isnull / exact=None 路径保留数组下标语义
items.evidence: The final has_key key is always compiled as "." + json.dumps(key) in the shared as_sql, so the fix covers SQLite, MySQL and Oracle. KeyTransformIsNull.as_sqlite/as_oracle and KeyTransformExact.as_oracle switch to HasKeyOrArrayIndex, so ints there are still array indices. Intermediate path segments are unchanged.
